subject: Unlock more with Lyft and DashPass 🤝
snippet: Link your accounts and start saving
body:
LYFT & DOORDASH

Lyft is better with DashPass

Good news alert: DashPass members who link their Lyft and DoorDash accounts can start saving on rides and DoorDash orders.

Link accounts

Not on DashPass yet? Claim your 3-month free trial to:

Get 5% off on-demand rides and 10% off scheduled airport rides (up to 4 rides/month, every month).

Save time with 2 free Priority Pickup upgrades per month.

Enjoy $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on eligible DoorDash orders. On average, DashPass members save $5 per eligible order.

These perks keep going as long as your DashPass account is active.

Save with DashPass
